$comment: Which files are user-facing, and therefore bound by the product vocabulary. Add a surface here the moment it starts shipping strings to a person: a status catalogue, an error-message table, onboarding copy, CLI help text. Globs are deliberately narrow — a broad glob turns this gate into background noise that lanes learn to route around.

surfaces.note: The master PRD. Carries the state mapping, the six status words, the ceremony-free journey and the whole requirement inventory, so it opts into every rule.

T174 (`01KZC2SCYPFMTDBTR35V9NXYXN`) landed the file this entry was the standing contract for, so `required` went true the same day: the surface now fails if the catalogue is deleted, rather than quietly resolving to nothing again. `statusPath` selects the status of each of the six entries. The wordings under `$.internalStates` are deliberately NOT selected: four of them — Their work, Shared version, Approve to shared version, Earlier version — name a thing rather than a state, and checking them against the six words would force a seventh meaning onto one of the six.
Shipped copy has no exemption: a suppression directive found here is itself a finding.

Every shipped TypeScript source in the desktop application, not only the copy directory. It covered `src/strings/**` alone until T174, which is the shape of coverage that reads well and misses the thing that actually leaks: two sentences a person can read were written inline at the `throw` site in `src/app/operations.ts`, outside every surface named here. An error message is copy. Tests are excluded because they ship to nobody and because a fixture must be able to contain the term it is proving the matcher catches. The excluded pattern must match something or the manifest fails, so it cannot rot into a hole. The mode is `source-strings` and not `json-strings` for the reason the old id recorded: a single `{json,ts}` glob in json-strings mode covered both extensions and the JSON extractor only sees double-quoted literals, so every forbidden term written in idiomatic single quotes or a template literal was invisible and the surface reported clean. Mode and extension are cross-validated at manifest load, so that pairing cannot be written again.
Error and notification text the desktop client renders verbatim.
